annotations.title: List data orders and download links

description: List the data orders on the account behind an Engagemii data API key: order number, records, date, status (preparing, ready or pending), the refresh of scores older than 30 days (state, how many rows were stale, how many are rescored so far, when the refreshed file was ready), and a download link for each ready file. The same as GET https://api.engagemii.com/api/v1/data/orders. Requires an Engagemii data API key.

api_key.description: Your Engagemii data API key (edk_...). Only needed when the key is not already sent as a request header.
